question: Which Indian information technology company won the 2020 ‘IBM Beacon Award’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Infosys.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Infosys company won the 2020 ‘IBM Beacon Award’.**
 
• **The Infosys Prize for 2019 was announced at the Infosys campus in Bengaluru.**
 
 
• The award is given annually to honor outstanding achievements in six categories:
 
• **Humanities: Manu V. Devadevan, jeevitha: Manjula Reddy, Mathematical Sciences: Sidhartha Mishra, Physical Sciences: G. Mugesh, Social Sciences: Anand Pandian, Engineering and Computer Science: Sunita Sarawagi.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SJVN **has been conferred with the** Dun & Bradstreet - Corporate Award 2021 in the category of Best Growth Performance-Power.**
 
• The award was presented at a virtual conference titled India's Top 500 Companies 2021.
 
• The event, with the central theme** 'Laying the Foundations for an ESG-Ready Corporate India',** featured keynote addresses by several eminent dignitaries.
 
• With a robust portfolio of** 31 projects of about 10,000 MW in the pipeline**, SJVN for itself has set an ambitious target of achieving** 5000 MW **installed capacity by** 2023, 12000 MW by 2030 and 25000 MW by 2040.**
 
• SJVN today has ventured into Thermal Power, Wind, and Solar energy generation, and electricity transmission also.
 
• For more than two decades,** Dun & Bradstreet** has been compiling the list of India's Top 500 Companies, which represent the leaders among Corporate India, and the driving force of the Indian economy.
